follow-up time: Until discharge from the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
outcome: Time to initiation of enteral feeding
cohort: 120 term neonates diagnosed with birth asphyxia
finding: Intravenous magnesium sulphate administration to term neonates with birth asphyxia within six hours of birth was associated with improved seizure control, faster resolution of neurological abnormalities, earlier initiation of enteral feeding, and reduced neurological abnormalities at discharge.
